source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιοι Γαβριήλ και Σιώνιος οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The same calendar names him again on 22 Ιανουαρίου, in the company of Manuel of Adrianople, whose page tells the same martyrdom under Mourtagon and says «τους Γαβριήλ και Σιώνιο τους αποκεφάλισε» (https://www.saint.gr/1148/saint.aspx). The two entries are read here as two commemorations of the same man, so the row records the day whose page names him with Sionios alone and this note records the other.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
